lines.t: Everything which comes from the mouth of the Lord your God
A song for all those who have ears to hear.
A vision to all who have eyes to see my splendor.
painted by the word of my glory,
an overflowing fountain inside those whose hearts are open to me.
Says the Lord, it is written,
man shall not live by bread alone,
alone, but by every word that proceeds from the mouth of God.
